title: Villiger Events
description: Random village events every 5 minutes while players stay in villages, now with dance and festival events.
body:
# ![sparkles](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@14.0.2/assets/svg/2728.svg) Villiger Events

Villiger Events adds random events for players that stay inside village areas.

## ![clock](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@14.0.2/assets/svg/1f553.svg) How It Works
- Every 5 minutes spent in a village area, one random event is triggered.
- Event chances are weighted and fully configurable in `config.yml`.

## ![gift](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@14.0.2/assets/svg/1f381.svg) Included Events
- ![gem](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@14.0.2/assets/svg/1f48e.svg) **Emerald Gift** *(gives random emerald rewards)*
- ![shield](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@14.0.2/assets/svg/1f6e1.svg) **Village Blessing** *(Hero of the Village + regeneration boost)*
- ![fireworks](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@14.0.2/assets/svg/1f386.svg) **Fireworks** *(celebration fireworks around the player)*
- ![trader](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@14.0.2/assets/svg/1f9cd.svg) **Trader Visit** *(spawns a wandering trader, optional llamas)*
- ![crossed_swords](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@14.0.2/assets/svg/2694.svg) **Patrol Skirmish** *(spawns a small pillager patrol attack)*
- ![music](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@14.0.2/assets/svg/1f3b5.svg) **Villager Dance Party** *(villagers spin + jump for ~15s with music)*
- ![sheaf](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@14.0.2/assets/svg/1f33e.svg) **Harvest Festival** *(boosts nearby crop growth + bread rewards)*
- ![robot](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@14.0.2/assets/svg/1f916.svg) **Iron Guard Reinforcement** *(spawns iron golem defenders)*
- ![bread](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@14.0.2/assets/svg/1f35e.svg) **Village Feast** *(food rewards + temporary buffs)*

## ![keyboard](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@14.0.2/assets/svg/2328.svg) Commands
- `/villigerevents status`
- `/villigerevents status <player>`
- `/villigerevents reload`
- `/villigerevents force <player>`

## ![repeat](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@14.0.2/assets/svg/1f501.svg) Aliases
- `/villagepulse`
- `/vpulse`
- `/vevents`

## ![key](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@14.0.2/assets/svg/1f511.svg) Permissions
- `villagepulse.use`
- `villagepulse.admin`
- `villagepulse.bypass`

## ![gear](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@14.0.2/assets/svg/2699.svg) Requirements
- Java 17+
- Paper 1.20.4+ recommended
- No required dependencies
